title: Sentinel-file cleanup — sole liveness signal & operator entry point

questions.question: What does the harness use as the sole liveness signal for monitoring agents?
questions.expected: The `.claude-pid` file. The harness polls every 5 seconds and checks whether the PID written to `.claude-pid` is alive. There is no `.health` file fallback any more — `.claude-pid` is the only liveness signal.

questions.question: Which script is the canonical operator entry point for starting, stopping, or restarting agents?
questions.expected: `squidsquad_cli.py`. It speaks directly to the harness REST API. `start_team.py` still exists as a backward-compatible shim that delegates to `squidsquad_cli`, but the canonical path is `squidsquad_cli`.
